visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair styled in a high bun stands before an ornate gold-framed mirror, meticulously applying makeup to her lips. She is dressed in a white long-sleeved shirt under beige overalls. The background reveals a brightly lit indoor space with a wooden table holding a drink and a small bag. (2) A second individual with short dark hair, wearing a striped shirt over a graphic tee, bursts into the frame. They point playfully at the camera before aggressively claiming space at the mirror to check their reflection. The scene is augmented with white radiating lines and pink comic-style graphic overlays. (3) The first woman steps back, directing an exaggeratedly shocked and annoyed gaze toward the lens. She claps her hands together as the intruder continues grooming. Red and yellow flame graphics appear around the frame, signaling her rising frustration while the second person remains oblivious in the mirror. (4) The second person leans in closer to the mirror, touching their face, while the first woman looms behind them with a mixture of impatience and amusement. The scene concludes with a dramatic close-up of the interaction, framed by intense flickering red flame graphics that dominate the visual edges.
